meaning: true URDF angle = the shared mapping's URDF angle + correction (per URDF joint, named by its motor)
method: 15 left-arm poses with its wrist camera on the desk ChArUco board (12 usable): the board located by the head camera (PnP), the left wrist intrinsics (0.38 px), its hand-eye and the five joint offsets fitted on the corners' reprojection; leave-one-out within ~1 deg for pan / lift / elbow / wrist pitch; the roll (-4.6, unstable to 7.6 deg) is left at 0. It also explains the 11:17 run: the joints sent with the wrong -30.2 wrist correction put the real jaw 28 deg tip down.

superseded.why: fit on poses where the head saw the left jaw from behind (fixed jaw hidden by the wrist camera board); the first left grasp still found the fixed jaw 3.6 cm off (10:27), and it pushed the rest pose past the elbow limit

superseded_list.why: head-depth fits on the left arm are unreliable (its wrist camera board sits elsewhere than the URDF draws it and dominates the head's view); with wrist -30.2 the real fingertips pointed down to the desk while the model had them level 10 cm up (11:17)

wrist_note: the board fit's wrist pitch (-2.92) trades off against the wrist camera's mount angle; at a level pre-grasp the user saw the jaw tipped up ~5 deg (11:48), so 5 deg more (-7.92)
